intro: The Whirlwind Weapon quest marks the final empowerment of a warrior's weapon using the whirlwind heart claimed from the elemental Cyclonian. By binding the beast's tempestuous core into a chosen vessel, the wielder claims the very essence and fury of the storm. It serves as an iconic milestone in martial mastery.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I have the whirlwind heart, and am ready to place it within your vessel of choice.
Choose your weapon, friend, and know that its power is the power of Cyclonian.
